_readme: Shortcuts New-DesktopShortcuts.ps1 puts on the desktop. Replace these with your real ones. Name = shortcut name. Target = program / file / folder / UNC path, or a URL (becomes an Internet Shortcut). Optional: Arguments, WorkingDirectory, Icon ('file.ico', 'file.exe,0' or 'shell32.dll,14'), RunAsAdmin (true/false), Description. %ProgramFiles% etc. are expanded. Example file: 20-Desktop-Experience\shortcuts-EXAMPLE.json
